label: Galois_representation_from_automorphic_representation_on_GL_2_form
title: Galois_representation_from_automorphic_representation_on_GL_2_form
statement: \notready Given an automorphic representation $\pi$ for an inner form of $\GL_2$ over a totally real field and with reflex field~$E$, such that $\pi$ is weight 2 discrete series at every infinite place, there exists a compatible family of 2-dimensional Galois representations associated to $\pi$, with $S$ being the places at which $\pi$ is ramified, and $F_{\p}(X)$ being the monic polynomial with roots the two Satake parameters for $\pi$ at $\p$.
